paragraphs: Rabbi Yose ben Kipper, in Rabbi Shimon Shezuri’s name: Rosh Hashanah 13b and Tosefta, Sheviit, chapter 2. And Dostai and Zekharyah ben Kevutal; see his entry. Rabbi Dostai be-Rabbi Yehudah: Tosefta, Sheviit, chapter 2. Yevamot 11b and Sifrei, Tetze, the section ‘She leaves his house’: he spoke in Rabbi Elazar ben Azaryah’s name. They sent him to Rabbi Chananyah, son of Rabbi Yehoshua’s brother, so that he would not intercalate years outside the Land; see his entry. In Rabbi Eliezer’s name: Niddah 47b. Rabbi Yose ben Kipper in Rabbi Eliezer’s name: Tosefta, Sheviit, chapters 1 and 2. He expounded in Rabbi Elazar ben Shammua’s name: tractate Derekh Eretz, chapter 1; Jerusalem Talmud, Sheviit 2:4 as cited. See 2:3:5 in the checked edition; Jerusalem Talmud, Beitzah, chapter 4; Yevamot 11b. Rabbi Achai be-Rabbi Yoshiyah.
